answer: In a bonded PoA system, each identity escrows collateral, while coordinated equivocation is penalized across the detected cluster: for k linked identities, pairwise evidence creates penalties proportional to k(k−1)/2, or O(k²), not merely separate per-key fines. Detection can also compound asymmetric depreciation of remaining stake, imposing an exponential multiplier on a swarm’s capital loss. A fable about a raven guarding a wharf is only a metaphor; cryptographic proofs establish liability.
